subject: Social Media
title: The Humane Technology Movement
description: A fast breakdown of The Humane Technology Movement for builders.

hook.text: Tristan Harris left Google to fight the attention economy. He called smartphones 'the new tobacco.'

buildup.text: His Center for Humane Technology argues platforms must be redesigned with human wellbeing as the metric.

discovery.text: The Social Dilemma documentary brought his message to millions. Tech insiders confessed their own guilt.

twist.text: Critics call it alarmist. Platforms made small changes—grayscale modes, reminders—but core models stayed.

climax.text: Harris argues voluntary moves aren't enough. Regulation must force platforms to prioritize wellbeing.

punchline.text: The builders rang the alarm. Nobody changed the blueprint.

quiz.question: What does the Center for Humane Technology advocate?
options: Redesigning platforms with human wellbeing as the metric
